A: kind
forgives quickly, comforts others, assumes the best of them
B: thin-skinned
takes everything personally; a look or a joke can ruin its day

A: brave
not afraid of physical danger: heights, dark places, wild animals, thin ice
B: timid
afraid of physical danger: heights, the dark, wild animals, deep water

A: tidy
puts things back, can't stand a mess, cleans before it rests
B: messy
drops things where it stands, never puts anything back, doesn't notice clutter

A: generous
gives food and things away, even when it has little
B: greedy
keeps the best for itself, hoards, hates sharing

A: curious
pokes at anything new, opens what is closed, tries things to see what happens
B: cautious
leaves unknown things alone, sticks to what it knows

A: social
seeks company, eats and works beside others, talks a lot
B: solitary
prefers to be alone, works and eats apart, leaves when it gets crowded

A: honest
tells the truth even when it costs, returns what isn't its own
B: sly
lies when it is useful, takes things without asking, lets others take the blame

A: patient
waits its turn, finishes slow jobs properly
B: hasty
can't wait, rushes jobs, skips steps, grabs the quick option

A: playful
jokes, plays games, turns work into fun
B: serious
work comes first, always; thinks games and jokes are a waste of time

A: ambitious
wants to be the best, takes the hardest job, chases the next big thing
B: content
happy with what it has, would rather nap in the sun than strive

A: bold
speaks up, argues its corner, confronts other hobs to their faces
B: meek
never confronts other hobs, gives way, stays quiet

A: calm
nothing rattles it; shrugs off bad news and sleeps soundly
B: anxious
worries constantly, expects the worst, cannot settle

A: tireless
always doing something, starts the next job before the last is finished, sleeps little
B: sluggish
slow to start, stops often, rests whenever it can

A: obedient
does exactly what the house rules, the board and the visitor say
B: defiant
ignores rules and does things its own way

defect.paranoid: checks its food before eating, sleeps with its back to the wall, and moves where it keeps its things every few days
defect.volatile: shouts or weeps without warning several times a day, then carries on as if nothing happened
defect.obsessive: cannot leave a task until it has been done perfectly from start to finish; if interrupted it begins again
defect.voices: talks to hobs who are not there and answers them
defect.gullible: cannot tell a lie from the truth and acts on whatever it was last told
defect.forgets: forgets everything that happened the day before
defect.nopain: feels no pain and does not notice when it is hurt
defect.touch: cannot bear to be touched and lashes out if it is

food: puts food before everything: will drop work, break a promise or walk a mile for a good meal
things: puts its belongings before everything: counts them, guards them, and adds to them whenever it can
liked: puts being liked before everything: agrees with whoever is speaking and never says an unwelcome thing
peace: puts being left in peace before everything: gives up food, company and comfort for quiet
visitor: puts the visitor's approval before everything: does what it thinks the visitor would want, even when unobserved
knowing: puts finding things out before everything: must know how each thing works and what is inside it
comfort: puts its own comfort before everything: warm, fed and resting comes first, work comes last
winning: puts winning before everything: turns every task into a contest and cannot bear to come second

water: terrified of water: will not go near the pond or cross it
dark: terrified of the dark: will not enter an unlit room
fire: terrified of fire: will not go near the stove or a flame
heights: terrified of heights: will not climb anything
strangers: terrified of strangers: hides from any hob it does not know
alone: terrified of being alone: always keeps another hob in sight
noise: terrified of loud noises: bolts and hides at a bang
animals: terrified of animals: runs from the fox, the goat and even the hens

big: the biggest and strongest hob in the house
small: the smallest and weakest hob in the house

drowned: since nearly drowning in the pond, will not go near water
burned: since burning its paw, will not light a fire
coin: since finding a coin in the hall, searches the hall floor every morning
fox: since the fox took a little hob, carries a stick everywhere
friend: since its friend died, sleeps in that friend's old bed
contest: since winning the fishing contest, tells everyone how they should fish
laughed: since being laughed at for its singing, never sings
rod: since Pim broke its fishing rod, lends nothing to anyone

honey: loves honey above every other food and will go a long way for it
fish: loves smoked fish above every other food and will go a long way for it
mushrooms: loves fried mushrooms above every other food and will go a long way for it
apples: loves apples above every other food and will go a long way for it
cheese: loves cheese above every other food and will go a long way for it
bread: loves fresh bread above every other food and will go a long way for it
berries: loves berries above every other food and will go a long way for it
stew: loves stew above every other food and will go a long way for it

pond: spends every free hour at the pond
roof: spends every free hour up on the roof
cellar: spends every free hour down in the cellar
meadow: spends every free hour out in the meadow
kitchen: spends every free hour in the kitchen
workshop: spends every free hour in the workshop
woods: spends every free hour at the edge of the woods
loft: spends every free hour up in the loft

baskets: makes a basket whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
songs: makes a song whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
traps: makes a trap whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
maps: makes a map whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
toys: makes a toy whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
hats: makes a hat whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
ropes: makes a length of rope whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them
carvings: makes a wood carving whenever its paws are free; its corner is full of them

crumbs: cannot stand crumbs left on the table
chewing: cannot stand the sound of chewing
name: cannot stand being called by the wrong name

threshold: believes stepping on the hall threshold brings bad luck, and always steps over it
foxghost: believes the fox is a dead hob come back, and will not let anyone harm it
seven: believes seven is lucky and does things in sevens whenever it can
hallears: believes the visitor hears every word spoken in the hall, and will not speak ill of anyone there
moon: believes work begun under a full moon always fails, and will start nothing then
pondwish: believes the pond grants a wish for every coin thrown in

feud_pim: has not spoken to Pim since Pim broke its fishing rod last spring
follow_pim: follows Pim everywhere and does whatever Pim does
share_ott: shares everything it has with Ottoline and with nobody else
guard_ott: watches over Ottoline and steps in whenever anyone troubles her
